> 第15章 雪狼群（第1页）
霜狼小径的寒风依旧刺骨，凯撒对照着地图和眼前逐渐降低的地势，确信冰裂谷就在前方那片布满巨大冰棱的隆起地带之后。
周围的雪山高度也在明显的降低，外海的模糊轮廓已然显现。
凯撒眼神锐利，目光扫过地图上的狼头标记，内心警惕但并未慌乱。
他没有走明显的小径，而是伏低身子，借助怪树林边缘的阴影和起伏的地形，无声息地向前摸去。
终于，在最后两座雪山山脉之间的垭口，他看到了冰裂谷的入口。
然而，只是看了一眼，他的心就彻底沉了下去。
地图标识得没错，但亲眼所见的震撼远超预期。
在那狭窄入口内侧的背风处，赫然散布着几个用枯枝和积雪堆砌起来的简陋巢穴
凯撒面色凝重，这些雪狼的体型，它们庞大得超乎想象！
每一头成年雪狼都接近两米，身躯粗壮无比，其体型比他前世的棕熊还要庞大，而且不止一个，是连成一片的一个小巢穴群
他缓缓缩回一块巨大的冰岩后面，大脑飞速运转。
“硬闯等于给这群雪狼加餐，绕路……”
凯撒看向一旁的怪树林，在夜色下显得更加狰狞，未知风险太大。
天色迅速暗沉，气温开始急剧下降，刺骨的寒意穿透皮甲，凯撒摸了摸几乎冻僵的脸颊。
“只能再等等了，希望这群家伙晚上会活动……”
凯撒思索片刻，果断后退，远离狼巢的视线范围，在更后方一处被几块巨大岩石环绕，相对隐蔽的角落里停了下来。
他仔细检查四周，确认安全后，才极其小心地用收集来的枯枝和搜刮来的火石头，升起了一簇极其微弱的火堆。
火苗很小，仅能提供一点点可怜的热量和光照，勉强驱散刺骨的寒意，并加热一小块冻硬的肉干。

凯撒将身体蜷缩在岩石的阴影里，尽量不让火光外泄，同时倾听着周围的动静，尤其是峡谷入口方向。
然而，就在他刚啃下两口温热的肉干时！
一声充满痛苦与恐惧的狼嚎猛地从峡谷入口方向传出，瞬间撕裂了夜晚的寂静！
紧接着，更多充满着愤怒与惊恐的狼嚎声，以及肉体被撕裂的可怕声响混杂在一起！
凯撒眼神一凛，瞬间抬脚碾灭了刚刚升起的火堆，确保不留一丝火星和烟雾，整个区域瞬间再次陷入一片昏暗和冰冷。
强烈的警惕心和获取信息的需求压倒了一切。
凯撒立刻俯下身，凭借着岩石和雪堆的掩护，迅速朝着声音来源的方向摸去。
每前进一段距离，那战斗的声响就更加清晰一分，其中夹杂的雪狼痛苦悲鸣和那种诡异的尖锐嘶鸣声让他头皮发麻。
终于，他爬到了一处能够俯瞰峡谷入口的雪坡上，小心地隐藏在几块碎冰之后。

> Chapter 15 Snow Wolves (Page 1)
The cold wind on the Frostwolf Trail was still biting. Caesar compared the map and the gradually lowering terrain in front of him and was convinced that the Ice Creation Valley was behind the raised area covered with huge ice edges in front of him.
The height of the surrounding snow-capped mountains has also been significantly reduced, and the vague outline of the outer sea has appeared.
Caesar's eyes were sharp and he scanned the wolf head mark on the map. He was alert but not panicked.
He did not take the obvious path, but lowered his body, using the shadows and undulating terrain at the edge of the strange forest to move forward silently.
Finally, at the pass between the last two snow-capped mountains, he saw the entrance to the ice chasm valley.
However, after just one glance, his heart sank completely.
The map marked it correctly, but seeing it in person was far more shocking than expected.
In the lee of the narrow entrance, there are several simple nests built with dead branches and snow.
Caesar's face was solemn. The size of these snow wolves was beyond imagination!
Each adult snow wolf is close to two meters, and its body is extremely strong. Its size is larger than the brown bear in his previous life, and there are more than one, and they are a group of small dens connected together.
He slowly retreated behind a huge ice rock, his mind working rapidly.
"Forcibly breaking in is equivalent to giving these snow wolves extra food, taking a detour..."
Caesar looked at the strange forest on the side, which looked even more ferocious in the night. The unknown risk was too great.
The sky quickly darkened, the temperature began to drop sharply, and the biting chill penetrated the leather armor. Caesar touched his almost frozen cheek.
"We can only wait a little longer. I hope these guys will be active at night..."
Caesar thought for a moment, then retreated decisively, away from the sight of the wolf lair, and stopped in a relatively hidden corner further back, surrounded by several huge rocks.
He carefully checked the surroundings and after confirming that it was safe, he used the dead branches he collected and the flint stones he collected to raise an extremely weak fire.
The flame was small, providing only a meager amount of heat and light, barely able to dispel the biting chill and warm a small piece of frozen dried meat.
Caesar huddled in the shadow of the rock, trying not to let the firelight escape, and at the same time listened to the movements around him, especially in the direction of the entrance to the canyon.
However, just as he took two bites of warm jerky!
A wolf howl full of pain and fear suddenly came from the direction of the entrance of the canyon, instantly tearing the silence of the night!
Immediately afterwards, more wolf howls filled with anger and fear were mixed together, as well as the terrifying sound of flesh being torn apart!
Caesar's eyes flashed, and he instantly raised his foot to extinguish the newly raised fire, ensuring that no trace of sparks or smoke was left. The entire area instantly fell into darkness and coldness again.
An overwhelming sense of vigilance and an overwhelming need for information.
Caesar immediately leaned down, relying on the cover of rocks and snowdrifts, and quickly moved in the direction of the source of the sound.
Every time he advanced a certain distance, the sound of the battle became clearer. The painful screams of the snow wolves and the weird sharp hissing mixed with them made his scalp numb.
Finally, he climbed to a snowy slope overlooking the entrance to the canyon, carefully hiding behind a few pieces of broken ice.
